svg.title: DorkOS systems and deployment boundaries
svg.desc: The DorkOS client reaches a local execution server. Community has its own browser, server and storage. Cloud is optional. The website and local installer both read marketplace sources. The remote-community connection is unfinished.

div.style: color: rgb(24, 48, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
